articles.title: Report to Congress on U.S. Military Operations Against Iran’s Missile, Nuclear Programs
articles.summary: The following is the Oct. 20, 2026, Congressional Research Service report, U.S. Military Operations Against Iran’s Missile and Nuclear Programs. From the Report On February 28, 2026, the United States and Israel launched military operations against Iran.

articles.title: Startup Biosphere wins Pentagon contract to scale up production of key chemicals
articles.summary: The biomanufacturing facility will boast 20,000 liters of UV-sterilized vats, able to brew anything from “bio-cement” for helipads to explosives for Hellfire missiles.

articles.title: U.S. Army and DVGW strengthen partnership during municipal water infrastructure visit
articles.summary: TRIER, Germany — A group of 15 public health specialists from Public Health Command Europe recently toured regional water facilities in Trier to share best practices and explore innovative approaches to water security and environmental sustainability.

articles.title: Fort Drum named Best Garrison for IMCOM-Western Hemisphere
articles.summary: Fort Drum was recently named 2026 Best Garrison for U.S. Army Installation Management Command-Western Hemisphere, recognizing its exceptional operational readiness, transformative energy resilience, and commitment to Soldiers and their families.

articles.title: Modernized Wellford Readiness Center Reopens, Strengthening Upstate Readiness and Community Ties
articles.summary: The South Carolina National Guard, state legislators and local civic leaders marked the reopening of the renovated Wellford Readiness Center during a ribbon-cutting ceremony on October 23, strengthening training and emergency-response capabilities for South Carolina National Guard Soldiers in the Upstate.

articles.title: BS27-1: Joint tactical fuel system
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force Airmen assigned to the 18th Logistics Readiness Squadron and U.S. Marines assigned to Marine Wing Support Squadron-172 established a joint tactical fuel system using both Air Force and Marine Corps contingency equipment during Exercise Beverly Sword 27-1 at Kadena Air Base, Japan, Oct. 28, 2026.

articles.title: Public Health Command Europe laboratory earns renewed accreditation, strengthens force health protection
articles.summary: LANDSTUHL, Germany — Public Health Command Europe’s Laboratory Sciences Division has renewed its accreditation, reaffirming its ability to deliver reliable scientific data that helps protect service members, families and other military communities across Europe, U.S. Central Command and U.S. Africa Command.

articles.title: Freedom Flag 26-2: U.S. Seventh AF, ROK AFOC commanders conduct ‘Friendship Flight’ at Kunsan AB
articles.summary: KUNSAN AIR BASE, Republic of Korea – U.S. Air Force Lt. Gen. David Shoemaker, Seventh Air Force commander, and Republic of Korea air force Lt. Gen. Jun-sun Cha, Air Force Operations Command commander, conducted a Friendship Flight during Freedom Flag 26-2 at Kunsan Air Base, ROK, Oct. 27, 2026.

articles.title: Beyond the comfort zone: 15th OSS Airman completes Army Ranger School
articles.summary: For Staff Sgt. Max Fuller, completing the U.S. Army Ranger School meant more than reaching a long-standing personal goal. It meant learning to lead under pressure, recover from setbacks and bring those lessons back to his Air Force mission.

articles.title: USACE Manager of the Year: Jisun Kang leads Far East District contracting
articles.summary: Jisun Kang, chief of contracting at the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Far East District, has been named Manager of the Year through the USACE Excellence in Contracting Awards Program.

articles.title: Brunson Challenges Logisticians to Bring Modern Technology into Exercises at 10th UNC Logistics Symposium
articles.summary: U.S. Army Gen. Xavier T. Brunson, commander of United Nations Command, told logisticians from 15 nations that sustainment is central to winning, as he opened the 10th Annual UNC Logistics Symposium at the Morning Calm Conference Center, Oct. 26, 2026.

articles.title: KEEN SWORD 27: 3rd EOD Company and Japan Ground Self-Defense Force EOD conducts live fire ground response training
articles.summary: U.S. Marines with 3rd Explosive Ordnance Disposal Company, 9th Engineer Support Battalion, 3rd Marine Logistics Group, trained alongside Japan Ground Self-Defense Force members during a bilateral live-fire ground response training on Okinawa, Japan, Oct. 23, 2026.

articles.title: TAMC physician honored for 30 years of continued Army service
articles.summary: Tripler Army Medical Center, HI — Dr. Conrad S. Belnap, a physician at Tripler Army Medical Center, received a medallion from the U.S. Army Medical Department on Oct. 19 in recognition of completing 30 years of active-duty service in the U.S. Army Medical Corps.
